quote: Låt dina kunder beställa online. Få ordrar direkt i kassan och ha full kontroll över beställningarna.
note: Not shown as included. The Express plan's own list of what it includes is: 'Molnbaserat system', 'Alla betalsätt', 'Automatisk rapportering', 'Support 24/7', 'Backoffice'. Online ordering does not appear in it. The same page describes Yabie Online in a separate section, 'Komplett kassasystem', with the quote above, plus 'Du får alla ordrar direkt in i kassan och dina gäster kan hämta ut sin mat utan att behöva stå i kö' and 'Inget krångel eller extra kostnad för dig eller dina kunder.' The page never says Yabie Online is part of the 899 kr plan, and it doesn't call it an add-on either. 'No extra cost' is ambiguous: it may mean no extra cost to customers or no transaction fees. A site-restricted search found no Yabie pricing page that answers the question. Verdict: there's no verbatim quote showing that the priced plan includes online ordering.
